items.name: Quarry-Oath Ring
items.lore: Every quarryman of Grimspound wears one. It is cut from the same block as the giants' standing stone.

items.name: Heartstone Pendant
items.lore: A sliver of the giants' heartstone. It grows heavier when you lie.

items.name: Jory's Chisel-Pin
items.lore: A mason's chisel, its edge filed down into a bracer-pin. It still bites.

items.name: Granite-Weave Mantle
items.lore: Grey cloth that falls in stiff folds like rock. Giants will not strike someone who wears it - or so the story goes.

items.name: Golestandt Scale Brooch
items.lore: A sliver of dragon scale the size of a thumbnail. It is still warm, weeks later.

items.name: White Hart Mantle
items.lore: Sir Wystan's own cloak, singed at the hem.

items.name: Ash-Grey Signet
items.lore: A dragonslayer's ring, its stone gone milky from the heat.

items.name: Slayer's Vow-Belt
items.lore: Every notch a vow. Some of them are crossed out.

items.name: Ember-Heart Bracer
items.lore: A bracer of blackened bronze that the dragon's breath could not melt.

items.name: Excavator's Pick-Pin
items.lore: A pick-head, filed into a bracer-pin.

items.name: Dig-Dust Belt
items.lore: Grey with rock-dust that never quite beats out.

items.name: Survey-Stake Charm
items.lore: A splinter of stake, painted white. White like a dragon.

items.name: Rockgrinder's Ring
items.lore: Ground smooth from a lump of granite.

items.name: Watch-Road Mantle
items.lore: Dust-grey, with the Watch's red dragon struck through.

items.name: Kez's Crushing Gauntlet
items.lore: Huge. You wear it on your forearm like a bracer, and it still overhangs.

items.name: Demolisher's Torc
items.lore: A twist of iron wedges.

items.name: Pony-Hair Charm
items.lore: Rough brown hair, braided with a blue thread.

items.name: Herdsman-Hide Bracer
items.lore: Thick grey hide.

items.name: Tegbuk's Herd-Staff Charm
items.lore: The tip of a giant's herding staff. It's the size of your arm.

items.name: Oath-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Granite, cut by a giant who broke an oath.

items.name: Moor-Wind Mantle
items.lore: Heather-brown, woven by Grimspound's women.

items.name: Stonecaller's Throat-Stone
items.lore: A smooth grey pebble. Hold it to your ear and it hums.

items.name: Ring-Stone Belt
items.lore: Grey stones on a leather strap.

items.name: Speaking-Stone Ring
items.lore: It whispers, very faintly, in a voice too big for it.

items.name: Dragon's-Song Bracer
items.lore: Etched with the stonecallers' song - backwards, to undo it.

items.name: Herald's Voice-Stone
items.lore: Black glass, cracked. The voice has gone out of it.

items.name: Silent-Ring Torc
items.lore: Grey stone, cool. It doesn't hum.

items.name: Oath-Keeper's Mantle
items.lore: Grimspound's own: grey wool with the quarry-mark in red.

items.name: Outlooker's Eye-Stone
items.lore: A glassy pebble the giants used as a lens.

items.name: Pounder-Fist Bracer
items.lore: Dented, deliberately.

items.name: Knocker's Lamp-Charm
items.lore: A tiny lamp, still lit, that won't go out.

items.name: Deep-Seam Ring
items.lore: Tin, from the deepest seam in Dartmoor.

items.name: Throne-Warden's Seal
items.lore: A granite seal, cut with a crown and a dragon.

items.name: Stonelord's Girdle
items.lore: Huge links of iron, cut down to fit.

items.name: Dragon-Watch Mantle
items.lore: Red, with a white dragon struck through. The Watch's own.

items.name: Gogmagog's Crown-Stone
items.lore: A chip of the giants' throne. It's warm.

items.name: Watch-Oath Ring
items.lore: Silver, with a dragon in chains.

items.name: Quarry-Oath Torc
items.lore: Granite and silver, cut from Grimspound's oldest block.
